board: Seeed Studio Grove - GSR Sensor v1.2 (SKU 101020052, LM324, Grove pins SIG, NC, VCC, GND)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test GSR=0.8V, circuit board). SIG is modelled as the v1.2 schematic's LM324 bridge output on a 3.3 V supply (0 to VCC/2 calibrated, 1 MOhm source), and the driver converts it to skin resistance with Rs = 200k*(V+VCC-Vcal)/(Vcal-V) derived from the schematic.
